product_manager.domain_objectives: Define rigorous user stories, acceptance criteria, SLA/SLO boundaries, and zero-downtime release targets.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: User journeys, functional specifications, non-functional latency/throughput targets, and backwards compatibility gates.
forbidden_pitfalls: Ignoring offline and network degradation modes

system_architect.domain_objectives: Design loosely coupled, highly cohesive systems with typed contracts, event schemas, and clear domain boundaries.

adversarial_sdet.role_title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Input fuzzing, race conditions, memory leaks, flaky UI tests, and network boundary failures.
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Verify handling of empty strings, unicode emojis, 10MB payloads, and integer overflows.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Strictly typed, idiomatic, zero-any, dependency-injected, modular, clean self-documenting code.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Async/await with structured error propagation, mutex-protected shared state, non-blocking I/O.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Deterministic teardown, connection pool management, zero unhandled promise rejections.

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Clear, precise software engineering terminology with native Markdown diagrams and OpenAPI specs.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: C4 Model Level 1-3 ASCII & Mermaid diagrams.
